sloka: अन्यथा क्रियमाणे तु अवध्यः स भविष्यति ।यदि त्वेवं कृते वीर विनाशमुपयास्यति ।। ७.६३.३० ॥
transliteration: anyathā kriyamāṇe tu avadhyaḥ sa bhaviṣyati ।yadi tvevaṁ kṛte vīra vināśamupayāsyati ।। 7.63.30 ॥

translations.english: If this is done otherwise, he will become unkillable, but if you act in this manner, O hero, he will certainly meet his destruction.
